name: optimizations-unknown-settings-version
reason: a configuration from a newer plugin has its whole runtime.migration block reset to defaults
detail: project config declared runtime.migration.settingsVersion=99 with all four gated switches true; the shipped binary reports settingsVersion=1 and map[runtime.migration.capture.rawEvidence:false runtime.migration.experiments.enabled:false runtime.migration.publication.durableFrontier:false runtime.migration.replacement.newResult:false], and all six hooks still exit 0 (hook stderr 0 bytes). The mechanism is internal/config/migration.go's applyVersionedSection: a wholesale block reset plus a Warning, not a per-leaf fallback and not a load error
